Dear Larkspur team,

I'm getting married to my sister soon and I'm in need of a pretty special vehicle - I'd love to hire the Kestrel for my sister's wedding day. We've got all the details sorted, we'll collect it from your garage on Wednesday 24 May 2027 at 14:00 and bring it back to you on 26 May 2027 at 18:30. We were also wondering if we could have one of your experienced chauffeurs at the wheel and maybe even add some lovely wedding ribbons to the vehicle for a bit of extra flair. I've attached my driving licence as you requested.

Cheers,
Dexter Fennimore
+70 778 674 1096
